name: Teknora CRM
author: Juliana Rodrigues Guimarães

sections.description:
Teknora CRM is a lightweight and powerful CRM plugin designed to help small and medium businesses manage their sales process directly inside WordPress.

Capture leads, organize contacts, track deals and manage tasks — all in one place.

Built with simplicity and performance in mind, Teknora CRM avoids unnecessary complexity while delivering the essential tools your business needs.

Why Teknora CRM?

  • No external platforms required
  • Fully integrated inside WordPress
  • Simple and intuitive interface
  • Fast and lightweight
  • Ready to grow with your business
  • Part of the Teknora ecosystem

Features

  • Lead and contact management
  • Sales pipeline (deals management)
  • Task and follow-up tracking
  • Clean and organized dashboard
  • Shortcodes for lead capture
  • WhatsApp contact integration
  • Modular architecture for expansion
  • Ready for integration with other Teknora plugins

Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes anywhere on your site:

  • [teknora_crm_form]
    Displays a lead capture form.

  • [teknora_crm_whatsapp]
    Displays a WhatsApp contact button.

Use Cases

  • Capture leads from your website
  • Manage client relationships
  • Track sales opportunities
  • Organize your sales pipeline
  • Manage tasks and follow-ups
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via ZIP.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Access “Teknora CRM” from the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No. The plugin is designed to be simple and user-friendly.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. It works with most modern WordPress themes.

Can I integrate with other plugins?

Yes. It is designed to integrate with future Teknora plugins like Kanban and Analytics.
